test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following initiatives was launched by the National Commission for Women (NCW) on 22 May 2025 to promote AI literacy and digital safety among women, especially in rural and semi-urban areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashoda AI: Your AI SAKHI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** launched the initiative **Yashoda AI: Your AI SAKHI** on **22 May 2025**. This program focuses on promoting **AI literacy** and ensuring **digital safety** for women, particularly those residing in **rural** and **semi-urban areas**.
 
• **Yashoda AI** aims to empower women by educating them about **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, its applications, and potential impacts. This initiative also equips them with tools and knowledge to protect themselves in the digital space.
 
• The program is designed to bridge the **digital divide** between urban and rural areas, ensuring that women in less privileged regions have access to technology and understand its benefits as well as risks.
 
• The name "**Sakhi**" reflects the idea of creating a **friendly and accessible digital companion** for women, helping them navigate the increasingly tech-driven world.
 
• This initiative aligns with the NCW’s broader objectives of empowering women, promoting **gender equality**, and ensuring their active participation in technological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW):**

 
 
• The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** is a statutory body established under the **National Commission for Women Act, 1990**. It aims to promote and protect the rights of women across **India**.
 
• The NCW addresses issues related to **women’s empowerment**, safety, and equality, including initiatives to ensure their participation in **technology** and **digital spaces**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of AI Literacy for Women:**
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** is transforming various sectors, including healthcare, education, and employment. Women’s awareness of AI can help them access **better opportunities** and safeguard themselves against **digital threats**.
 
• Programs like **Yashoda AI** are crucial in rural and semi-urban areas where technological awareness is relatively low, creating opportunities for women to leverage digital tools.
 
 
 
• **Comparison of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Tech Sakhi: Empowering Women:** This name suggests a support system for women in technology but lacks the specific emphasis on AI literacy and digital safety.
 
• **Digital Shakti: Women in Tech:** While this name focuses on technology and women empowerment, it does not specify the role of AI or the rural outreach aspect.
 
• **Cyber Sakhi: AI Awareness Program:** This name emphasizes AI awareness but does not highlight the broader goals of literacy, empowerment, and safety for women in rural areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Yashoda AI: Your AI SAKHI:**

 
 
• **Target Audience:** Women in **rural** and **semi-urban areas**, where access to technology and digital resources is limited.
 
• **Focus Areas:** AI literacy, digital safety, and empowering women to utilize technology for **personal** and **economic growth**.
 
• **Implementation:** Partnerships with local communities, organizations, and experts to facilitate workshops, training, and outreach programs.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Initiative:**
 
 
• Promotes **gender inclusivity** in technology and addresses the **digital divide** in India.
 
• Creates awareness about the **opportunities** and **challenges** posed by AI technologies.
